title.en: Hong Kong's IPO boom is developing a performance problem

facts.en:
- As Hong Kong vies with Wall Street to be the top IPO market, a growing number of pre-debut runups turn sour after their listing.
- Only seven companies cited oil prices as a reason for cutting or not updating their profit outlooks for the year.
- As bitcoin dropped to its lowest price since 2024, investors flock to a new type of crypto investment linked to the hyperliquid platforms, HYPE ETFs.

- 随着比特币跌至自2024年以来最低价，投资者涌入一种与超流动性平台相关的新型加密货币投资，即HYPE ETF。
facts.es:
- Mientras Hong Kong compite con Wall Street por ser el principal mercado de OPI, un número creciente de aumentos previos al debut se vuelven amargos después de su cotización.
- Solo siete empresas citaron los precios del petróleo como razón para recortar o no actualizar sus perspectivas de ganancias para el año.
